messages:
maria: Heads up — the Python quickstart async example in docs uses the sync client pattern. When I followed it I got a RuntimeWarning about a coroutine never awaited and the KV-cache anchor link returns 404: https://docs.redwood.ai/python/quickstart#kv-cache
kevin: Oof, thanks for flagging. Can you paste the exact snippet you ran?
maria: Sure — here's what the docs currently show:
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
async def main():
    gen = await client.generate("hello")
    print(gen.text)
```
maria: Running that gives: "RuntimeWarning: coroutine 'Client.generate' was never awaited" — so the client isn't being `await`ed/entered properly.
jon: Looks like the snippet didn't get updated after the async client API changed (we switched to async context manager). Also confirmed the `#kv-cache` anchor 404s on the published page.
docs-bot: Created docs issue #458: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/issues/458 (automated)
kevin: I'll take this. Plan: update the example to use `async with Client() as client:` and add a short note about versions. I'll also fix the anchor or add a redirect.
maria: For folks hitting this now, quick workaround: use `async with Client() as client:` or if you need sync, use the sync helper (`from redwood.sync import Client`) depending on your install.
kevin: Draft PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/789 — includes updated snippet, anchor fix, and a tiny FAQ blurb about coroutine warnings.
jon: Tested locally against the PR — snippet runs clean, and the KV-cache link resolves. :thumbsup:
maria: Nice. Can we also add a one-liner in the quickstart about "if you see coroutine warnings, check you used async with or the sync client" for newcomers?
kevin: Yep adding that now. Also going to add a CI lint that renders code blocks to catch this class of errors.
sam: Good call on CI tests — I'll add an issue to infra to include docs snippet execution in the pipeline.
kevin: Will follow up with the PR linking the infra issue.
maria: Awesome, thanks everyone :rocket:
